content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states only that the Agency 'concluded that Complainant failed to prove that he was subjected to discrimination as alleged,' with no evidence analysis or reasoning connecting the allegations in (k)-(q) to that conclusion, and claims (a)-(j) are referenced but not described."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Some items cite the ROI (at 246-7 and 49-51), and allegations are attributed to Complainant or relayed by an HSS, but the 'witness' who reported to the IG is unidentified, and no source is given for the Agency's merits findings or any management responses."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Incidents (k)-(q) are dated between approximately April 15 and August 10, 2018, though listed in reverse order, but the procedural steps (EEO counseling, ROI issuance, hearing request and withdrawal, final decision, appeal) carry no dates, and the dates of claims (a)-(j) are absent."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"Procedural criteria are noted (claim (g) dismissed for not being raised at counseling, untimely discrete acts treated as background, decision issued under 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b)), but no decision-maker is identified, no merits standard is stated, and there is no indication that SHSS's explanations or Complainant's responses were weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the reasoning, decision-maker, management evidence, and descriptions of claims (a)-(j) are missing and the text is truncated, an independent reviewer could not determine from this record whether the no-discrimination finding is supported."}}}
